mapper.select: select fi.fulfillment_item_id, fi.fulfillment_id, fi.order_item_id, fi.quantity, fi.create_time, oi.order_id, oi.sku_id, oi.sku_code, s.product_name from fulfillment_items fi left join order_items oi on oi.order_item_id = fi.order_item_id left join order_item_snapshots s on s.order_item_id = fi.order_item_id where fi.fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} order by fi.fulfillment_item_id asc

select oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.sku_id, oi.sku_code, oi.quantity, s.product_name from order_items oi left join order_item_snapshots s on s.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id where oi.order_id = #{orderId} order by oi.order_item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into fulfillment_items (fulfillment_id, order_item_id, quantity, create_time) values (#{fulfillmentId}, #{orderItemId}, #{quantity}, sysdate())
